column2: # Relevel binary variables so "No" is the reference category
# This makes every odds ratio read in the intuitive direction (exposed vs. unexposed).
df$birth_weight_low <- relevel(df$birth_weight_low, ref = "No")  # OR = low vs normal birth weight
df$born_early       <- relevel(df$born_early, ref = "No")        # OR = preterm vs full-term
df$asthma           <- relevel(df$asthma, ref = "No")            # model P(asthma = Yes)
df$cigarettes       <- relevel(df$cigarettes, ref = "No")        # OR = smoker vs non-smoker household
